subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper allows 28% discount on the marked price of an article and still makes a profit of 20%. If he gains ₹3,080 on the sale of one article, then what is the selling price (in ₹) of the article?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Here, 20% = 3080 ⇒ 100% = 3080 × 5 = 15400 The given profit = 3080 The selling price = 15400 + 3080 = 18480 ∴ The selling price (in ₹) of the article is ₹18480
